roles/cloudsupport.admin.title: Support Administrator
roles/cloudsupport.admin.desc: Allows management of a support account and support cases. See the Cloud Support documentation for more information.

roles/cloudsupport.advisorySupportEditor.title: Advisory Support Editor
roles/cloudsupport.advisorySupportEditor.desc: Full read-write access to advisory support cases applicable for Cloud Customer Care.

roles/cloudsupport.advisorySupportViewer.title: Advisory Support Viewer
roles/cloudsupport.advisorySupportViewer.desc: Read-only access to advisory support cases applicable for Cloud Customer Care.

roles/cloudsupport.supportSubscriptionEd.title: Support Subscription Editor
roles/cloudsupport.supportSubscriptionEd.desc: Full read-write access to support event subscriptions.

roles/cloudsupport.supportSubscriptionVi.title: Support Subscription Viewer
roles/cloudsupport.supportSubscriptionVi.desc: Read-only access to support event subscriptions.

roles/cloudsupport.techSupportEditor.title: Tech Support Editor
roles/cloudsupport.techSupportEditor.desc: Full read-write access to technical support cases (applicable for Cloud Customer Care and Maps support). See the Cloud Support documentation for more information.

roles/cloudsupport.techSupportViewer.title: Tech Support Viewer
roles/cloudsupport.techSupportViewer.desc: Read-only access to technical support cases (applicable for Cloud Customer Care and Maps support). See the Cloud Support documentation for more information.

roles/cloudsupport.viewer.title: Support Viewer
roles/cloudsupport.viewer.desc: Read-only access to details of a support account. This does not allow viewing cases. See the Cloud Support documentation for more information.
